description.it: Il catechismo breve, composto per ordine di Clemente VIII (1597), in quattro classi di domande e risposte da imparare a memoria, con gli atti delle virtù. Testo dell'edizione Vivès (1870-74), da scansione OCR.
description.en-US: The short catechism composed by order of Clement VIII (1597), in four classes of questions and answers to be learned by heart, with the acts of the virtues. Italian only: the Vivès edition (1870-74) from an OCR scan.
description.pt-BR: O catecismo breve composto por ordem de Clemente VIII (1597), em quatro classes de perguntas e respostas para decorar.

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 12 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain. Italian.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.
